text: Vale locks in with the fountain crew for good, telling Flint straight up his sluice-gate demands feel like control games while Dusk's information theory clicks for her. Flint calls her flip "predictable," refuses to soften, and keeps pushing Lumen away too, insisting only hard numbers matter — no comfort, no cordial, no feelings. Dusk cranks up the fear talk, framing the Islands as fragile and the town's kids as proof something important is being drained out of Marla City. Meanwhile Reed's eerie calm deepens as even the ever-friendly Elsie won't wave back, and Lumen quietly starts wondering if Flint is the one squeezing Vale.
